Well, there could be several reasons for this not happening:
-Cultural way of doing it: one side expect one type of response for a problem while the other does it a compleatly different way (their way of doing it) and it keeps the issue going
-Them actualy saying what they dont understand, but it a broken and confusing way, and reciving answers that they joust see as the same answer as before (becouse of language barrier) and gives up trying to ask for a explenation out of frustration and joust throws "stuff at the wall" to see if that works
-Tinking they understand it (but they dont actualy) and going with that and geting no-were, and joust leaving both sides confused/frustrated

Or other reasons/combinations, sometimes people need a loot of "investigativ problem solving" to find the answer/solution, but that stuff can take a lot of time and effort, someting I can understand that the council/Cordone leadership proberly dont have a lot off after all the normal "maintenance" and development of Cordone and the IRL stuff they most likely also need to deal with.
